task.title: Deliver one-command customer EKS deployment CLI
task.description: Implement #555 as the sole customer EKS provisioner by extending the shipped metrum-smartrouterctl. One deploy invocation must create or resume one isolated licensed Router from an approved profile and reference-only intent, while plan/status/delete and config or release updates share one normalized idempotent lifecycle. Implement idempotent plan, deploy, status, and separately authorized delete in metrum-smartrouterctl with fake-first AWS, EKS, RDS, release, secret, license, and Router adapters.

Compose existing EKS discovery, immutable-image delivery, isolation, migration compatibility, license/config revision, activation, exact-host routing, retry, retention, and cleanup contracts without staging-specific hardcoding.

Treat configuration or release changes as a new approved immutable intent reconciled by the same deploy lifecycle; never accept or persist raw config, credentials, DSNs, kubeconfigs, license payloads, or shell commands.
acceptance: One metrum-smartrouterctl deploy command creates or resumes one isolated licensed non-production Router without manual aws, kubectl, RDS, DNS, certificate, secret, license, or workload steps after invocation.

Plan is deterministic and read-only; deploy/status/delete are profile- and job-scoped, bounded, redacted, idempotent, and safe under duplicate, concurrent, timeout, partial-failure, retry, and unknown ownership cases.
Config and release updates pin exact approved config/license revisions and one immutable image digest across retries; no serving Host route or ready state exists before activation passes.

Namespace identity, least-privilege RBAC, network isolation, resource limits, dedicated private RDS/PVC, secret references, license, Router, shared wildcard TLS, and exact Host routing are automated and verified.

All #555 standalone suites, disposable non-production EKS E2E, and independent security/operations review pass before live deploy is enabled; production profiles remain rejected until #518 authorizes them.

internal/router/tenant_instance_registry.go explicitly has no AWS, Kubernetes, DNS, RDS endpoint, router database, secret, or live quota adapter; scripts/eks_delivery.py is staging-policy-bound and is not the shipped customer CLI.
GitHub #555 is the open canonical implementation epic; #581 is closed for the safe fake-adapter slice, #507 is complete, and #545, #586, and #518 remain open cross-cutting dependencies.
